d: Short, curly espresso-brown hair is styled with a side parting and adorned with a red floral accessory and a silver beaded headband. The eyes are a deep crimson with a calm, neutral expression, set on a youthful face with a mature air. The build is slender, dressed in an oversized black blazer over a white lace slip dress featuring long, layered crimson fringe and white pearl draping. Signature details include a red handgun and black pointed-toe heels with metallic silver accents.
